mission_10: Generate X with np.random.randn(100, 3) and set seed for reproducibility.
Add bias column with np.column_stack([np.ones(100), X]).
Normal equation: w = np.linalg.inv(X_bias.T @ X_bias) @ X_bias.T @ y.
R-squared = 1 - SS_res / SS_tot where SS_res = sum((y - y_pred)^2).
Center data by subtracting the mean of each feature before PCA.
